description.en: A right-sidebar chat panel for DeepSeek Harness. Open the right sidebar and choose "DeepSeek 对话" to start. Multi-session chat with streaming, deep thinking, web search, attachments, voice input/read-aloud and OCR; switch between DeepSeek official, Harness-configured models, iFlytek Spark and your own OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints. Type a drawing request (e.g. "画一只猫" / "draw a cat") to generate images inline via a configured image service (Qwen, Volcano, SiliconFlow, Tencent Hunyuan/TokenHub or a custom endpoint), with a gallery, large-image viewer and edit derivation. Includes per-reply token/TPS/cache stats, auto context compaction, conversation export (Markdown/text/PNG), history ZIP import/export, personalization, custom background, scheduled automation, app connectors (GitHub/Gmail/Outlook/QQ) and an animated desk pet. API keys are stored in Harness credentials, never in the browser; chat and image requests are sent to the providers you configure. Turning the plugin off removes the panel and stops its background automation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏对话面板。打开右侧栏选择「DeepSeek 对话」即可开始。支持多会话流式聊天、深度思考、联网搜索、附件、语音输入/朗读与 OCR；可在 DeepSeek 官方、Harness 已配置模型、讯飞 Spark 与自定义 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容端点之间切换。在聊天里直接发绘画请求（如「画一只猫」/「draw a cat」）即可通过已配置的图像服务（千问、火山、硅基流动、腾讯混元/TokenHub 或自定义端点）inline 出图，配图库、大图查看器与编辑派生。另含每条回复的 token/TPS/缓存统计、长上下文自动压缩、对话导出（Markdown/文本/PNG 长图）、历史 ZIP 导入导出、个性化回复风格、自定义背景、定时自动化、应用连接（GitHub/Gmail/Outlook/QQ）与动画桌宠。API Key 存于 Harness 凭据存储，浏览器不持有密钥；聊天与生图请求会发送到你配置的服务商。关闭插件即移除面板并停止其后台自动化。
